The '''Lifh sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vilosoria]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Lifh sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
